Lina M.: Heads-up: StellarGrid sent INV-SG-0487 for $8,912 but PDF has no PO and line description 'Platform consumption'. Vendor says due in 8 days. Can procurement confirm PO or ask for reissue?
Invoices Bot: New invoice: INV-SG-0487 uploaded  amount $8,912  status: unmatched. Link: https://accounting.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-SG-0487
Greg T. (Procurement): Checking  we have PO-80330 for 'Platform credits' but it's for $7,500. Likely an overage. @StellarGrid Billing can you annotate PO-80330 on the invoice and break out the overage?
StellarGrid Billing: Hi team  our auto-bill omitted PO on PDF when usage exceeded commitment. We can reissue INV-SG-0487-R1 with PO-80330 applied to the committed portion and a separate line for overage. Want both PO numbers on header?
Lina M.: Single PDF is fine as long as PO is on header and line items map to GL codes.
Maya (AP): Please include GL mapping and remittance info. If PO is on header we can auto-match committed portion; overage will need cost owner approval.
Greg T. (Procurement): We'll create a supplemental PO if needed: PO-80330-S1 to cover the delta. Procurement will update vendor with both PO numbers to include on the reissue.
StellarGrid Billing: Reissue planned today. We'll include PO-80330 and PO-80330-S1 on header and add line-item breakdown + bank details.
Invoices Bot: Invoice INV-SG-0487-R1 uploaded  amount $8,912  status: pending match. Link: https://accounting.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-SG-0487-R1
Anika (Finance Manager): Routing note: invoices >5k need finance review. I'll review once matched. Please route to 'eng-platform' cost center and GL 5200-INF-PLATFORM per Greg.
Maya (AP): Received. I'll hold payment until match and Anika sign-off, then schedule next AP run.
Lina M.: Thanks everyone  documenting vendor ticket: "StellarGrid invoice omitted PO when usage > committed; reissued INV-SG-0487-R1 with PO-80330 & PO-80330-S1; charge GL 5200-INF-PLATFORM; awaiting Anika review." :white_check_mark:
